_source: Core Rulebook, Wizard: Arcane Schools (legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/classes/wizard.html, raw HTML read 2026-10-05; d20pfsrd's classic arcane schools cross-checked). The specialist's extra slot and the opposition schools' double cost are rules/casting.py's; this file is what the school powers DO.
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. `power` is the key of a power in content/schools/powers.json; a character has the ability exactly when rules/grantedpowers.py lists that power as had (the choice made, the level reached), and spends the pool that file defines. `$energy` and the other variant fields are filled from the variant picked with the choice.
